title: Well comparison
status: gate met - AC-1..AC-5 met: a unit mismatch suppresses the delta and shows each cell's own unit, a missing value is '-' and never zero, the export is built from the displayed matrix, the overlay refuses wells without geometry and names them, and a new selection cancels the load in flight

implementation.service: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Data/Wells/OgWellCompare.cs (OgCompareWell, OgCompareCell, OgComparisonRow, OgComparisonMatrix.ToCsv, IOgWellComparison, OgWellComparison, BuildRows, OverlayDecision)
implementation.gate: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Core/OgCompareGate.cs (BeginLoad cancels the previous load and gives each a version; IsCurrent; SelectionChanged)
implementation.page: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop/Views/WellComparePageView.cs (route 'compare': multi-select well picker, dynamic matrix columns, overlay sentence, CSV export)
implementation.navigation: the well index has a Compare wells action
implementation.tests: test/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Tests/WellCompareTests.cs (5, no database) + WellCompareGatewayTests.cs (1 opt-in, real SQLite)

integration.wells: UWI-A (TD 3000 m, KB 110 m, coordinates), UWI-B (TD 10000 ft, KB 120 m, coordinates), UWI-C (no TD, KB 0, no coordinates)
integration.unit_mismatch: the total-depth row is marked unit-mismatched, each cell shows its own unit (3000 m / 10000 ft) and the difference column is empty
integration.missing_vs_zero: UWI-C total depth is '-' with no value; its KB is '0' with a real value, and the KB deltas are +10 m and -110 m against UWI-A
integration.picks: the pick-count row reads 2 / 1 / 0 from STRAT_WELL_SECTION
integration.overlay: refused for A+B+C naming 'UWI-C (surface coordinates)'; offered for A+B
integration.export: the CSV header is Property,Category,Unit,UWI-A,UWI-B,UWI-C,Difference and it has one line per matrix row; the rows carry the same cell text as the grid
integration.selection: two BeginLoad calls leave the first token cancelled and its version stale; SelectionChanged leaves the second stale too

smoke.well-compare-overlay: No overlay: there is no comparison.

gates.AC-1 A unit mismatch prevents a numeric: pass - a row whose wells disagree on the unit (or have a unit on one well and none on another) is marked UnitMismatch, every cell carries the flag, and Deltas stay empty; each cell shows its own unit so the mismatch is visible. The SQLite test compares 3000 m against 10000 ft and gets no difference text.
gates.AC-2 A missing value is distinct from ze: pass - a missing value becomes '-' with Value null and Missing true, while a real zero renders '0' with Value 0; the test checks both on the same well (TD missing, KB zero).
gates.AC-3 The matrix is exportable with the s: pass - ToCsv is built from the same OgComparisonMatrix the grid binds to: one header with the well columns and one line per row; the SQLite test asserts the row count, header and cell text.
gates.AC-4 The overlay refuses wells without t: pass - OverlayDecision requires a total depth with its unit and surface coordinates on every selected well and names each well and the missing part; A+B is offered while A+B+C is refused with 'UWI-C (surface coordinates)'.
gates.AC-5 Selection changes cancel pending lo: pass - OgCompareGate.BeginLoad cancels the previous token and gives each load a version; CompareAsync discards a result whose version is no longer current and the page calls SelectionChanged on every picker change. Unit tests cover both.

limits: The schematic overlay is gated, not drawn: the tools' WellComparison/ChangeOverlay is not referenced from the desktop, so the panel states availability and the drawing remains with the tools.
The export is CSV only; the plan's XLSX is not built.
Properties come from WELL (identity, status, geometry, dates) plus the count of stratigraphic picks; completion geometry and per-wellbore properties are not compared.
Deltas are against the first selected well and only for numeric rows; text and date rows have no delta by design.
The picker is limited to six wells and the well list to the first 250 wells (no search inside the picker).
The page is exercised by construction and by unit/integration tests; no automated click drives the picker or the grid.
